fields.name: Sword of Air and Darkness
fields.benefit: On a natural 19-20, target is transported to the ethereal plane for 1d6 rounds (Fort DC 14 resists). Once per day can cast darkness (100' radius) as a spell check result of 18.
fields.curse: The sword whispers the names of the slain to its wielder during sleep; Will DC 12 each night or lose 1 point of Luck permanently to the sword's hunger.
fields.desc: A black-bladed weapon with a faint moaning wind audible to the wielder.

fields.name: Ring of Spell Storing
fields.benefit: Can hold up to 3 levels of wizard or cleric spells (cast into it by any spellcaster). The wearer can release any stored spell as a free action, using the original spell check result at time of storage.
fields.curse: Ring becomes uncomfortably hot when a stored spell is released, dealing 1 HP of fire damage to the wearer per spell level released.
fields.desc: A plain silver band with a hair-thin crack that glows faintly when storing a spell.

fields.name: Potion of Giant Strength
fields.benefit: For 1 turn, treat Strength as 20 (modifier +4 to all Strength rolls and melee damage). Attack die improves two steps.
fields.curse: After the effect ends, 1d3 points of Strength are drained until the next long rest.
fields.desc: Tastes of iron and earth; roiling brown color.

fields.name: Gauntlets of the Ogre King
fields.benefit: Treat Strength as 18 while wearing. Can tear open doors, barricades, and locks as a warrior Mighty Deed at -2 to the deed die.
fields.curse: The wearer cannot perform tasks requiring fine motor skills (picking pockets, lock picking, spell casting with somatic components) without making a DC 12 Agility check.
fields.desc: Massive iron gauntlets engraved with a crude orc face.

fields.name: Cloak of the Mountaineer
fields.benefit: Grants a climbing speed equal to ground speed; automatically succeed at all climb checks except overhang (DC 12). Once per day, feather fall for 1 round.
fields.curse: Cloak whispers urges to scale things regardless of danger; Will DC 9 each time a tall structure is visible or the wearer must move toward it.
fields.desc: Brown and gray patches, always dusty regardless of cleaning.

fields.name: Staff of Disruption
fields.benefit: On a hit against an undead creature, it is turned (as per cleric Turn Unholy at a result of 18). On a natural 20 vs. undead, it is destroyed. Can be used to detect undead within 30' (vibrates).
fields.curse: Clerics of chaos cannot wield it — it deals 1d6 damage to them per round held.
fields.desc: Pale birchwood carved with intertwined holy symbols of three competing faiths.

fields.name: Helm of the Lizard King
fields.benefit: Grants command over all reptiles and lizard men within 60' (Will DC 12 to resist). Immune to fear while wearing.
fields.curse: Wearer cannot benefit from healing magic while wearing the helm — wounds close on their own (1 HP per hour).
fields.desc: Ornate scaled iron helm with a crest shaped like a lizard crest. Extremely uncomfortable.

fields.name: Boots of Mist-Stepping
fields.benefit: Once per day, step through up to 30' of air as a misty form (cannot be intercepted, pass through bars, move silently). Lasts 1 round — must materialize in unoccupied space.
fields.curse: After each use, save Fort DC 11 or be partially dematerialized — take 1d3 damage over 1d4 rounds as the body reforms.
fields.desc: Gray suede boots that never make sound; always slightly damp.

fields.name: The Grimoire of Zulmak
fields.benefit: A spell book containing three unique 3rd-level wizard spells (Zulmak's Binding Chains, Eye of the Undying, Whispers from the Dark). Reading it grants these spells as known spells (no normal study time required).
fields.curse: Each time a spell from this book is cast, roll d6: on a 1, the reader receives one level of corruption from Zulmak's residual influence. On a natural 1 spell check with these spells, greater corruption always results.
fields.desc: Black iron covers, pages of vellum, ink that remains wet to the touch.

fields.name: Amulet of Luck
fields.bonus: +1 Luck permanently when attuned (via week of wearing)
fields.benefit: Once per day, the wearer may reroll any single die result and take the better roll (declared before the reroll).
fields.curse: If the wearer dies while wearing the amulet, it shatters permanently.
fields.desc: A carved four-leaf clover in pale green jade on a simple cord.

fields.name: Scrolls of the Forbidden Summoning
fields.benefit: Contains the ritual for summoning a Demon Type II or III (judge's choice) without a spell check. The summoning is not bound — the demon is immediately hostile. Any caster reading the scroll must make Will DC 13 or be compelled to complete the ritual.
fields.curse: Compulsion DC increases to 16 if the reader is chaotic. Once read, the scroll crumbles to ash.
fields.desc: Stored in a lead tube; scrolls smell of sulfur; edges are scorched.

fields.name: Dagger of the Assassin
fields.bonus: +3 to attack and damage when attacking a surprised or unaware target
fields.benefit: On a backstab (thief ability), add +2d6 damage beyond normal backstab bonus. Once per session, may be used to deal automatic maximum damage on one attack when the target is unaware.
fields.curse: The dagger must taste blood at least once per week or it begins to drain 1 Luck per day from the wielder.
fields.desc: Narrow black blade with a notched edge; handle of dark bone.

fields.name: Eviscerator Blade
fields.benefit: A magic weapon that explodes its damage dice: every time the wielder rolls the maximum on a damage die, they roll another and add it, chaining as long as maximums keep coming. A hot streak turns one hit into a bloodbath.

fields.name: Medusa's Touch Blade
fields.benefit: A magic blade whose strike forces a Fort save (DC 1d10+10) or the victim is permanently turned to stone. One good hit can end a fight outright, though the DC swings with the roll.

fields.name: Blade of Great Strength
fields.benefit: While wielded, this magic weapon raises the bearer's Strength by +4, boosting melee attack and damage across the board. Its power vanishes the moment it leaves your hand.

fields.name: Holy Brand Weapon
fields.benefit: A blessed magic weapon that deals an extra +1d4 damage to unholy creatures, undead, and demons. Ordinary foes feel nothing special, but against the unclean it bites deep.

fields.name: Blade of Precise Strike
fields.benefit: A finely-honed magic weapon granting a +1d4 bonus to attack rolls, making hard-to-hit targets far easier to land. The bonus varies each swing but always helps.

fields.name: Whirlwind Strike Blade
fields.benefit: A magic weapon that lets the wielder trade their normal attack for two attacks in one round, each rolled with 1d10 instead of 1d20 (normal attack bonus applies). No critical hits are possible while whirling, trading big hits for volume.

fields.name: Armor-breaker Weapon
fields.benefit: On any critical hit, this magic weapon destroys the opponent's armor outright, on top of the normal crit effects, stripping their AC for the rest of the fight.

fields.name: Weapon-breaker
fields.benefit: On any critical hit, this magic weapon destroys the opponent's weapon (or maims natural weapons like claws and fangs), on top of the normal crit effects, leaving them disarmed.

fields.name: Throwing Blade
fields.benefit: A magic sword balanced for throwing up to 20' as a ranged attack that always flies back to the wielder's hand after the throw, so you never lose your weapon.

fields.name: Death Dealer (Bane Weapon)
fields.benefit: A magic weapon attuned to a specific kind of foe (its bane); when it strikes that bane, the creature must make a Fort save (DC 1d20+10) or die instantly. Against anything else it is just a fine blade.

fields.name: Hunter (Bane Weapon)
fields.benefit: A magic weapon that senses its designated bane within 100', even through invisibility or magical concealment, piercing such defenses as if with a +10 Will save. A relentless tracker against its chosen enemy.
